text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

The wins: reps reclaimed about 5 hours a week from CRM entry. Follow-up emails went out same-day, not three days later. Managers finally heard real customer objections instead of polished summaries.

The surprises: accuracy dipped in noisy plants and on speakerphone calls. Two customers asked us to turn it off, and we should have asked consent upfront, every time.

The lesson: the tool didn't improve selling. It removed admin so reps could focus on the conversation.

Our next step is a clearer consent script and a shared template for summaries.

Anyone else piloting AI note-takers in the field? What broke for you?
